Barrington, IL · 1-on-1 · No Referral Required

# Book Your _Physical Therapy Appointment_

Transparent pricing, simple scheduling, and 1-on-1 care with Dr. Julie Roy, DPT from your very first visit. Start with a free 20-minute injury consultation — or book your initial evaluation directly.

[Book Online →](https://intakeq.com/booking/sglmgu) [Explore treatment techniques](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques)

Serving Barrington · Lake Zurich · Palatine · Inverness · NW Chicago Suburbs

![Free injury consultation at Achieve Physical Therapy Barrington IL](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/79a3ed5f-e0fe-446c-8001-10d0f80b4903/Injury+Consultation.webp?format=1000w)

No Referral Needed

Illinois allows direct access to PT — no doctor's order required.

Treatment Starts Day One

Your first appointment includes hands-on treatment, not just intake forms.

Transparent Pricing

No hidden fees. Every cost listed clearly — including free options.

HSA/FSA Accepted

Superbills provided for out-of-network insurance reimbursement.

## How to Get Started

Three clear steps — from your first conversation to lasting results. No guesswork, no surprises.

Step 1![Free injury consultation at Achieve PT](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/79a3ed5f-e0fe-446c-8001-10d0f80b4903/Injury+Consultation.webp?format=800w)

### Free Injury Consultation

Free · 20 minutes · No commitment

Not sure if PT is the right next step? Let's talk. Dr. Julie will listen to what's going on, screen for anything that needs medical follow-up, and give you an honest recommendation — with zero pressure to book.

Step 2![Initial physical therapy evaluation at Achieve PT Barrington](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/dbde2478-aafa-4c9c-875f-342d3ea195b6/Initial+Evalutation.webp?format=800w)

### Initial Evaluation

$180 · 60 minutes

A thorough movement, strength, and symptom assessment — followed by hands-on treatment and a personalized home program you can start that same day. You'll leave knowing exactly what's going on and what the plan looks like.

Step 3![Physical therapy follow-up recovery session at Achieve PT](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/e5024007-5752-437b-985d-a05cd2401937/Recovery+Session.webp?format=800w)

### Follow-Up & Recovery Sessions

$80 (30 min) · $150 (60 min)

Every session has a clear goal and measurable progress markers. We build momentum visit by visit — progressing your plan, coaching you through the work between sessions, and tracking real milestones.

## Transparent Pricing

No hidden fees. No surprise bills. Every cost listed clearly before you book.

Free Injury Consultation20 minutes · Phone or in-person · No commitment

Free

Initial Evaluation60 minutes · Full assessment + hands-on treatment + home program

$180

Dry Needling30 minutes

$80

Follow-Up Session60 minutes

$150

**Treatment packages available:** Save 5% on a package of 6 visits, or 10% on 10 visits (60-minute sessions). Packages never expire and can be shared with family members. Initial evaluation required before purchasing a package.

HSA and FSA accepted. Cash, check, credit card (3% processing fee), Zelle, and Venmo also accepted. Superbills provided for out-of-network insurance reimbursement.


![Insurance-based PT vs. private pay PT comparison — fewer visits, faster results, often equal or lower total cost](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/027560bd-5a16-4fab-873f-ba714c05b269/insurance-vs-private-pt-1600w.webp?format=1000w)

Private pay PT often costs the same or less than insurance — with fewer visits and faster results.

## What to Bring

Everything you need to know before walking in the door for your first visit.

- Comfortable athletic clothing that allows access to the area being treated

- Any imaging, X-rays, MRI reports, or surgical notes

- A brief timeline of your symptoms — when it started, what makes it better or worse

- Any questions you've been wanting to ask — Dr. Julie welcomes them


**Treatment starts on day one.** Your initial evaluation includes hands-on treatment — not just assessment and paperwork. You'll leave with a clear diagnosis, measurable goals, and a home program you can start the same day.


## Pilates & Fitness at Tensile Strength Studio

Achieve PT is located inside one of Barrington's premier movement facilities — giving patients access to an exceptional rehabilitation environment.

![Tensile Strength Studio interior — Pilates and fitness facility in Barrington IL](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/bca3b67b-c32a-4a79-878c-fad227f03efc/Achieve+PT+Studio.webp?format=1000w)

### A 4,000 sq ft Movement Studio

Tensile Strength Studio offers a full Pilates studio, dedicated fitness class space, and cycle studio — all inside a light-filled, vaulted-ceiling space. Your PT sessions happen here, giving rehab access to reformers, squat racks, free weights, and balance tools not found in a typical clinic.

[Visit Tensile Strength Studio](https://www.tensilestrengthstudio.com/)

### Ready to Book?

Schedule your free 20-minute injury consultation or initial evaluation online — no referral needed.

The free 20-minute injury consultation is exactly for this — no forms, no commitment, no referral needed. Just a conversation about what's going on and whether PT makes sense.

[Book Free Consultation →](https://intakeq.com/booking/sglmgu) [Read Common Questions](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/faqs)

## Physical Therapy Appointments in Barrington, IL — Pricing & Scheduling

Achieve Physical Therapy & Wellness offers 1-on-1 physical therapy in Barrington, Illinois with Dr. Julie Johlie Roy, DPT. Free 20-minute injury consultations available with no referral required. Initial evaluation $180 (60 minutes). Follow-up sessions $80 (30 minutes) or $150 (60 minutes). Treatment packages of 6 or 10 visits available at 5–10% discount, never expire, shareable with family. HSA and FSA accepted. Superbills provided for out-of-network reimbursement. Located at 756 W Northwest Highway Suite B, Barrington IL 60010 inside Tensile Strength Studio. Serving Barrington, Lake Zurich, Palatine, Inverness, Hoffman Estates, Schaumburg, and the northwest Chicago suburbs. Call (847) 387-3610.

## How to Get Started

Three clear steps — from your first conversation to lasting results. No guesswork, no surprises.

Step 1![Free injury consultation at Achieve PT](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/79a3ed5f-e0fe-446c-8001-10d0f80b4903/Injury+Consultation.webp?format=800w)

### Free Injury Consultation

Free · 20 minutes · No commitment

Not sure if PT is the right next step? Let's talk. Dr. Julie will listen to what's going on, screen for anything that needs medical follow-up, and give you an honest recommendation — with zero pressure to book.

Step 2![Initial physical therapy evaluation at Achieve PT Barrington](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/dbde2478-aafa-4c9c-875f-342d3ea195b6/Initial+Evalutation.webp?format=800w)

### Initial Evaluation

$180 · 60 minutes

A thorough movement, strength, and symptom assessment — followed by hands-on treatment and a personalized home program you can start that same day. You'll leave knowing exactly what's going on and what the plan looks like.

Step 3![Physical therapy follow-up recovery session at Achieve PT](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/e5024007-5752-437b-985d-a05cd2401937/Recovery+Session.webp?format=800w)

### Follow-Up & Recovery Sessions

$80 (30 min) · $150 (60 min)

Every session has a clear goal and measurable progress markers. We build momentum visit by visit — progressing your plan, coaching you through the work between sessions, and tracking real milestones.
